quote: I like asking why. I love knowing why.
coreInfo:
I’m pretty sure my first word as a baby was “Why”, and I’ve been asking ever since. Asking why is easy, but the fun is understanding why.

I hunt for the human truth hiding in a boring stat and turn it into an insight a campaign can be built on. You can see it in my work below.

I moved to Melbourne knowing nobody, because it’s where the agencies are. I wanted real experience badly enough to take an internship almost two hours away. Now I want an agency strategy career where I never stop understanding new whys.
contactLine: I’m open for all coffee chats, campaign ideas and opportunities.
